root.name: Philidor Defense: Larsen Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4 exd4 4. Nxd4 g6

overview: After the Philidor exchange on d4 Black fianchettoes with 4...g6 and ...Bg7 instead of the usual ...Nf6 and ...Be7, reaching a Pirc-like set-up with the e-pawn already traded. White has the bigger centre and usually develops with Nc3, Be3 and Qd2, sometimes Bh6 or a slow kingside space plan. Black aims for ...Nf6, ...O-O and the freeing ...c5 or ...d5.

white_ideas.idea: Take space with Nc3, Be3, Qd2 or Be2 and keep the d4 knight active.
Exchange the g7 bishop with Bh6 or play Nd5 to harass Black's set-up.

black_ideas.idea: Develop ...Bg7, ...Nf6, ...O-O and challenge the centre with ...c5 or ...d5.
Keep the position compact and wait for White to overreach.

typical_structures.structure: Black pawns on d6, f7, g6 with the Bg7 behind them against White's centre pawn on e4 and d-file open.

character.notes: Black is compact and passive but hard to attack quickly; White has no forcing win, so the game is a slow manoeuvring fight.

gambit.notes: The d4 pawn is exchanged for a knight recapture; no material is given.

soundness.notes: A passive but sound set-up; Black concedes space but there is no refutation.

structure.notes: White's e4 pawn against Black's d6 with an open d-file gives a Pirc-style semi-open centre.

approach.notes: A named sideline of the Philidor; used by some strong players, so standard.

level.notes: Plans are clear for both sides and there is little forcing theory.

sublines_that_differ.name: Early Bh6 or Nd5 ideas
sublines_that_differ.moves: 5. Nc3 Bg7 6. Be3 Nf6 7. Qd2 O-O 8. Bh6
sublines_that_differ.how: White aims for a Pirc-style attack with Bh6 and h4-h5 against Black's fianchetto.

character.reason: Compact fianchetto set-up that is hard to break down, with White slowly pressing.

structure.reason: Pirc-like asymmetric centre with e4 against d6 and an open d-file.

approach.reason: A playable sideline of a respectable defence.

level.reason: Clear plans, modest theory and some patience needed against White's space.

plans.reason: Black's bishop on g7 against White's central space.
